sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE ELEMENTARY EDUCATION FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province
Elementary
Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002.
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary 14th January, 2004]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis:I/2004/1337,
dated 14-1-2004.-----The North-West Frontier Province Elementary Education
Foundation (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of North-West Frontier Province on the 29th December, 2003 and assented to by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 7th January, 2004 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Elementary Education Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 5 of
the N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XXX of 2002.---In ,the North-West Frontier
Province Elementary Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance
No.XXX of 2002), in section 5, in subsection (1),-
(a) in clause (a), for the word
"Governor", the words "Chief Minister" shall be
substituted; and
(b) in clauses (h), (i) and (1),
for the word "Governor", the word "Chairman" shall be
substituted.
